newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss to vote in June on rules for EU entry talks.
newsitem.headline: Swiss to vote in June on rules for EU entry talks.

text.p: Swiss voters will decide in June whether to force the government to seek their permission for any negotiations with Brussels over Berne's long-term goal of joining the European Union, the government said on Wednesday.
The Federal Council (cabinet) set June 8 as the referendum date for an initiative launched by Eurosceptic Swiss groups seeking popular approval for any effort toward Swiss membership in the EU.

No entry talks are on the immediate horizon after Swiss voters in 1992 rejected Swiss participation in the European Economic Area, a free-trade bloc formed by the EU and members of the European Free Trade Association.
